board: Winsen ZE07-CO electrochemical CO module (bare 15-pin module, pins 1-5 and 6-15)
reason: Modelled from the Winsen ZE07-CO manual V1.7: active-upload frame FF 04 03 01 CH CL 13 88 SUM (0.1 ppm per count, checksum NOT(sum bytes1-7)+1, verified against the manual example) streamed once a second at 9600 baud; the driver resyncs, checks the checksum and supports the Q&A commands.
